title: VIXEN build wrapper must discover or validate UNDERTOW_ROOT for Text
body: The queued baseline configure failed before compilation because Text/CMakeLists.txt requires UNDERTOW_ROOT; manually supplying the paired root recovered configuration. The facade/build wrapper should discover the consumer root or emit a preflight command with the required root.

title: VIXEN build wrapper and lane recipe disagree on Release argument
body: The brief recipe build-wsl.sh Release reached successful configure but cmake --build rejected positional Release; the documented wrapper accepts cmake build flags and the preset already selects Release. The lane-facing wrapper contract should normalize or reject this mismatch before a queued build.

title: Queue-submit protocol needs a reusable standalone test owner
body: The R723 facade is wired into production RenderGraph, but the existing standalone GPU node test had no queue-owner fixture; this lane had to hand-write MessageBus draining, completion publication, and command retirement in the test. Consolidate that harness so future submitter tests exercise the canonical owner without duplicating queue logic.

title: VIXEN FrameTargets gate must accept pinned Undertow schema metadata
body: The corrected queued all-build and frame_targets_schema_regen both fail before target validation: CodegenTool reports unsupported schema field fluent call 'WithInputGrammar' at staged Undertow.Content.Core.Declarations/ContentKinds.cs:114. No generated diff is produced; align the pinned CodegenTool/schema reader or the Undertow declaration contract so VIXEN can complete its required golden check.
